checkpoint.objective: Establish truthful repository-owned continuity for the new fork without changing product behavior.

requirements.statement: Record exact fork/upstream/base identity and discovery limitations in repository-owned durable evidence.
Persist Brainstorm proposals with context_only authority and keep selection separate from unselected ideas.
Persist an executable Implementation Request with exact base/branch/scope/rollback and separate implementation versus merge/deploy/release authority.
Change only .repo-steward/** in the implementation commit.
Do not claim runtime checks passed; explicitly retain NOT_RUN for unavailable local/npm/browser verification.

acceptance_criteria.description: Exact fork, upstream, default branch and base commit identities are durable.
Brainstorm proposals remain context-only and product ideas not selected are not implemented.
Implementation Request is bounded and preserves authority separation and rollback.
Verification distinguishes PASS from NOT_RUN and records the remote-only limitation.

included: Record current fork/default-branch/base identity and upstream relationship
Persist bounded Brainstorm alternatives and the selected continuity direction
Persist a buildable Research-to-Spec artifact and executable Implementation Request
Persist repository-scope verification and a durable handoff for a fresh agent
excluded: Product code or runtime behavior changes
Canonical .repo-steward/state.yaml initialization until a direct checkout can compute the Repo Steward content digest
YAML authoring support from upstream issue #16
Complete offline source-project export from upstream issue #17
GitHub Actions, pull request creation, merge, deploy, release, production data or secret changes

constraints: Do not invent a canonical content digest without direct-checkout evidence.
Avoid GitHub Actions when local/offline or repository-object verification is sufficient.
Do not expand into product feature work.

architecture_decisions.text: Use repository-owned .repo-steward artifacts for remote bootstrap, but defer canonical state.yaml until direct-checkout snapshot reconciliation.

research_conclusions.text: YAML authoring and complete source export are credible future candidates but are not selected.
Feature-branch pushes do not trigger the repository CI workflow; push to main or pull_request does.

non_blocking: Canonical Repo Steward content digest is unavailable from this remote-only session.
No local product runtime can be executed here.

verification_plan.procedure: Re-read main immediately before mutation and confirm base identity has not drifted.
Read back persisted Brainstorm artifact and confirm context_only authority and candidate separation.
Read back this Implementation Request and confirm identity/scope/rollback/authority fields.
Compare base to implementation commit and require only .repo-steward/** paths.

rollback.expectation: Delete the feature branch or revert only the scoped .repo-steward commits; no product/external runtime state changes.
